description.value:
Exotic mixed drug. Lasts 1 hour.

Primary: +4 Melee, Evasion and Dance; −1 COOL, Stealth and Ranged. No rushing penalties. Running gives attackers −2 to hit you. You can't end a Turn without moving; restrained, you take 1d6 HL.

Secondary (DV17): Move Action or Action each Turn unless dosed. The world runs too fast or too slow.

Recipe: Lite-Smash, Fishnet, The Juice, Synthcoke ×3, exotic chemical.
